metadata.source: Navy engine manual (Jan 1941) and TAIC Manual No. 1; see the part's engine.json
metadata.approximation: Two-speed supercharger approximated by its second-speed rating held flat to 4100 m (1460 hp in first speed at 2200 m is not representable). BSFC is the JSBSim model's auto-rich value at rated power, used for every mode; not sourced. Dry mass: engine.json dry mass.
